verdict.rationale: A government service website could reasonably publish a robots.txt, so this question applies to it. The only probe of a robots.txt returned HTTP 404 on the filing host (icis.corp.delaware.gov), which therefore publishes no crawl policy. No evidence shows a robots.txt on corp.delaware.gov either, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes also returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
